title: On the Union of Souls is now in circulation
body: The first doctrinal text of the Church is complete and available to enquirers on request. It sets out our teaching on the joining of the soul to the spark, and the conditions under which that joining is held to endure.

title: Before the Umbrella enters revision
body: Our working paper argues that the Ophite material is better read as proto-Gnostic than as a late branch of the Gnostic family. The current draft is being revised ahead of circulation to reviewers.

title: The Pleroma Archive continues to grow
body: Sources, translations and commentary are published separately at the Archive. New material is added there as it is checked rather than held back for a release.
